text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Phew… Okay, where should I buy my groceries today?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Whoa, the grocer near the station is doing a super sale on carrots.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I don't know, though. They'll probably have another sale at some point…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I'll just stick with a local place today. I don't feel like walking too far…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It looks like Ines Fujin is pretty fatigued from her back-to-back races. Revising her race schedule might be a good idea.
